info.title: Material KAI — Supabase Edge Functions
info.description:
OpenAPI for the **Supabase Edge Functions** (Deno/TypeScript) of the Material KAI Vision Platform.

This is the companion to the FastAPI-generated `openapi.json` at `https://v1api.materialshub.gr/openapi.json`, which covers the **MIVAA Python** backend only. Edge functions are a separate runtime with no auto-generated schema, so this spec is **hand-maintained** from the source code (`scripts/edge-endpoints.json` → `scripts/build-openapi-edge.mjs`).

Most functions are **action-based**: POST a JSON body with an `action` field; the spec models each action as a discriminated `oneOf` branch. Finance/REST-style functions use typed bodies or path/method routing (see each operation's description). Auth varies per function — see `security` and the scheme descriptions.

post.summary: Multi-agent LangGraph chat with tool execution and SSE streaming
post.description:
Stateful LLM chat endpoint supporting three agents (kai, interior-designer, demo). Uses LangGraph StateGraph for multi-step tool execution. Supports multimodal input (data-URL images), long-term memory, toolkit-based tool selection, and optional partner API key access. Returns SSE stream of JSON chunks; content-type text/event-stream.

**Response:** `[object Object]`

📖 [docs/docs/api/agent-chat-api.md](docs/api/agent-chat-api.md)

post.summary: Every-minute cron: dispatch background agents whose cron schedule is due
post.description:
Runs every minute via pg_cron. Evaluates all enabled background_agents with trigger_type='cron', parses their cron expression, and dispatches due agents to background-agent-runner. Includes concurrency guard to skip agents with an in-flight run.

**Response:** `{ success, checked, triggered, results: [{ agent_id, name, triggered, run_id?, error? }] }`

post.summary: Weekly cron (Sunday 00:00 UTC): sync AI model prices from hardcoded reference tables
post.description:
Reads ai_model_pricing rows with auto_update_enabled=true, compares current prices against a hardcoded per-provider reference (Anthropic, OpenAI, Voyage, Google, Firecrawl), updates changed rows, and writes an audit row to ai_pricing_update_logs. Accepts optional POST body to force-update or filter by provider.

**Response:** `{ success, message, stats: { models_checked, models_updated, models_skipped, models_failed, results }, timestamp }`

force_update.description: Ignore auto_update_enabled flag; check all rows

provider.description: Limit update to one provider (anthropic, openai, voyage, google, firecrawl)

post.summary: Every-5-minute cron: detect and recover stuck PDF, XML, scraping, and agent runs
post.description:
Scans background_jobs, scraping_sessions, and agent_runs for heartbeat-stale entries. Atomically claims each and re-dispatches to MIVAA or background-agent-runner. Terminally-failed exhausted PDF jobs are marked failed and HuggingFace endpoints are scaled to zero as a cost watchdog.

**Response:** `{ success, totalStuck, exhausted_failed, recovered, failed, results }`

get.summary: Execute a registered background agent by agent_id
get.description:
Universal executor for all background agent types. Accepts service-role or user JWT auth. GET ?catalog=1 returns the registered agent type catalog; POST runs or resumes an agent run.

**Response:** `{ success, run_id, status, duration_ms, output? }`

post.description:

run_id.description: Resume or update an existing pending run

post.summary: Every-minute cron: start scheduled campaigns and drip-send emails to recipients
post.description:
Transitions campaigns from status='scheduled' to 'sending' when their scheduled_at has elapsed. Then processes up to 8 pending recipients per campaign per tick by calling the email-api edge function. Marks campaigns complete (sent or partial_failure) when all recipients are exhausted.

**Response:** `{ success, processed, scheduledCampaigns, sendingCampaigns }`

post.summary: Proxy product attribute canonicalization to MIVAA facet service
post.description:
Internal-only thin proxy called by background agents (material-tagger, product-enrichment) to canonicalize raw product attributes through MIVAA's POST /api/admin/facets/canonicalize. Keeps MIVAA credentials in one place so background agents do not need to carry them. No auth enforced at the edge layer — network-level restriction applies.

**Response:** `[object Object]`

post.summary: Claude Sonnet vision pass over source PDFs to find materials matching a query
post.description:
Sends one or more admin-uploaded source PDFs to Claude Sonnet 4.6 with tool-use to extract candidate materials matching a free-form query. Returns candidates with name, description, price, specs, bbox, and a rasterized image URL.

**Response:** `{success, candidates:[{source_pdf_id,page_no,name,description,image_url,bbox,price,currency,specs}], partial_errors?}`

post.summary: Find candidate images for a catalog material via platform DB then web fallback
post.description:
Searches the platform product DB (via MIVAA multi-vector search) first, then falls back to DataForSEO Google Images SERP. Returns up to N image candidates tagged with source ('db' or 'web') for admin approval.

**Response:** `{success, candidates:[{source,thumb_url,full_url,title,source_metadata}], db_hits, web_hits}`

search_db_first.description: Whether to query platform DB before web (default true)

post.summary: Proxy to MIVAA rasterize-pdf-page; returns signed URL to a PNG crop of a PDF page
post.description:
Thin edge proxy that forwards a rasterization request to MIVAA's internal endpoint using the cron secret. Accepts an optional normalized [0..1] bbox to crop a region of the page. Called internally by catalog-extract-from-pdfs and catalog-translate-pdf.

**Response:** `{success, image_url, storage_path, width, height}`

post.summary: Whole-PDF vision pass to populate a catalog's body_data from a source PDF
post.description:
Sends an entire source PDF to Claude Sonnet 4.6 via tool-use to produce sections and materials, then merges the result into the target catalog's body_data. Supports layout-preserving (page-per-section) and restructured (category-grouped) modes.

**Response:** `{success, sections_count, materials_count}`

post.summary: Daily cron (08:00 UTC) that matches new products against active saved searches and sends bell notifications.
post.description:
Can also be triggered manually via POST (no secret required — uses service-role JWT from pg_cron Authorization header). For each active saved_search not yet due to re-alert, queries products created since last_recommendation_sent_at whose name or description matches the saved query, inserts deduped material_alerts rows, and writes user_notifications.

**Response:** `{processed: number, new_alerts: number, timestamp: string}`

post.summary: Sitemap-driven indexer for SEO inter-linking; preview or full crawl mode
post.description:
Discovers the sitemap via robots.txt or well-known paths, then either samples 5 URLs (mode=preview) or fully crawls up to max_pages URLs (mode=full), scraping each with Firecrawl and embedding the content via Voyage for SEO inter-linking. Accepts JWT or cron secret.

**Response:** `{success, mode, data:{sitemap_url?,pages_discovered,pages_indexed?,capped_at?,sample?,ok,error?}}`

mode.description: preview (5-URL sample, no full index) or full (default)

post.summary: Receives Resend delivery event webhooks and updates email_logs.
post.description:
Accepts POST from Resend (Svix-signed). Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature using `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and rejects requests with missing or invalid Svix headers. Maps Resend event types (sent, delivered, bounced, complained, opened, clicked) to internal `email_events` rows and updates `email_logs` status accordingly.

**Response:** `{success:true, event_type:string}`

data.description: Event data including email_id, from, to, subject; bounce/click details when applicable

post.summary: Send finance digest emails and dispatch quote follow-up bell notifications
post.description:
Cron mode (invoked by the Finance digest flow): sends scheduled digest emails with AR/AP aging, cash-flow forecast, P&L, and top-party tables to configured recipients, and dispatches bell notifications for idle or due-scheduled quotes. Now mode (admin JWT): sends an on-demand digest for a specific workspace.

**Response:** `{ok, digest?: {processed, dispatched, results}, followups?: {dispatched, skipped, queue_size}, recipients_attempted?, recipients_delivered?, errors?}`

mode.description: 'cron' for scheduled invocation from flow-engine; 'now' for admin-triggered send. (one of: string ('cron'|'now'))

job.description: Narrow cron run to one job; omit to run both. (one of: string ('digest'|'followups'))

workspace_id.description: now mode: target workspace; inferred from caller's membership if omitted. (string (uuid))

recipients_override.description: now mode: override recipient list (skips last_sent stamp).

post.summary: Re-query connector for pending MARK on offline-accepted fiscal documents
post.description:
Cron function that finds invoices and credit notes with fiscal_status='offline' (accepted by the connector while AADE was down) and calls fetchTransmitted on the connector to stamp the final MARK. Safe to run continuously; no-ops when nothing is pending.

**Response:** `{ok, invoices_checked, invoices_recovered, credit_notes_checked, credit_notes_recovered}`

post.summary: Pull inbound documents from myDATA (RequestDocs) for configured workspaces
post.description:
Polls the AADE myDATA RequestDocs endpoint for each workspace that has configured inbound credentials, upserts received documents into inbound_documents, and advances the per-workspace MARK watermark. Cron path charges 2 credits per workspace; manual 'Sync now' (JWT) is free. No-ops cleanly when credentials are absent.

**Response:** `{ok, workspaces, results: [{workspaceId, found, upserted, new_watermark} | {workspaceId, skipped|error}]}`

post.summary: Render a legal invoice, credit note, or delivery note as a PDF
post.description:
Generates an A4 PDF for an invoice, credit note, or delivery note using pdf-lib with embedded Noto Sans for Greek/Latin rendering. Caches the PDF in pdf-documents storage and returns a 7-day signed URL. Supports GR/EN language selection per-document.

**Response:** `{ok, pdf_url, pdf_storage_path, cached?}`

invoice_id.description: Invoice to render. Provide one of: invoice_id, credit_note_id, delivery_note_id. (string (uuid))

regenerate.description: Force re-render even if a cached PDF exists.

post.summary: Issue, transmit, or POS-complete a fiscal invoice/credit note/delivery note
post.description:
Creates a draft invoice from a quote (idempotent), optionally issues it, and optionally transmits it to the workspace's legal_invoice connector (Novus → myDATA). Also handles credit-note submission (myDATA 5.1), delivery-note submission (9.3), and POS/IRIS receipt hold + completion (Law 5155). Costs 2 credits per myDATA transmission; root workspace transmits free.

**Response:** `{ok, invoice_id, invoice, fiscal: {ok, status, mark, uid, qrUrl, ...} | null}`

quote_id.description: Create/find invoice from this quote. Provide this OR invoice_id. (string (uuid))

invoice_id.description: Operate on an existing invoice directly. (string (uuid))

credit_note_id.description: Submit a credit note (myDATA 5.1) to the fiscal connector. (string (uuid))

delivery_note_id.description: Submit a delivery note (myDATA 9.3) to the fiscal connector. (string (uuid))

issue_now.description: Flip invoice from draft → issued status.

submit_fiscal.description: Transmit to the workspace's legal_invoice connector.

fiscal_overrides.description: Per-call myDATA overrides: invoice type, series/aa, income classification. (object (FiscalOverrides))

pos_payment.description: Issue as card/IRIS receipt on a registered EFT-POS terminal (Law 5155). (object {terminal_id, pos_nsp_id, payment_type?})

pos_complete.description: Finalize a held POS/IRIS receipt after terminal charge succeeded. (object {pos_signature_id?, invoice_id?, transaction_id, payment_amount?, tip_amount?})

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session or pay-link for an invoice
post.description:
Two modes: authenticated admin/finance mints a pay_token and/or creates a Stripe Checkout session for an invoice; public/unauthenticated path resolves a pay_token and creates a Checkout session for the buyer. Routes funds to the workspace's connected Stripe account when configured.

**Response:** `{ok, checkout_url, session_id, invoice_id, pay_link?, pay_token?, amount?, currency?, customer_display?}`

invoice_id.description: Admin mode: invoice to pay. Requires JWT with finance role. (string (uuid))

link_only.description: Admin mode: mint/refresh pay_token + return public link without creating a Checkout session.

pay_token.description: Public mode: token from the pay link (e.g. from /pay/:token URL).

post.summary: Email an invoice to its customer with optional PDF attachment
post.description:
Resolves the recipient from the invoice's CRM company/contact, generates or reuses the invoice PDF, and dispatches via the email-api edge function. The 'to' field overrides automatic recipient resolution.

**Response:** `{ok, sent_to}`

to.description: Override recipient email; defaults to CRM customer email on file. (string (email))

post.summary: Render and email a party account-statement PDF (ledger / Καρτέλα)
post.description:
Single mode: renders a chronological debit/credit ledger PDF for a CRM company or contact and emails it. Cron-batch mode: iterates all workspaces with auto_statement_enabled and sends each eligible party their statement according to the configured schedule. Customer-side statements include pay-by-card links for open invoices.

**Response:** `{ok, email_sent_to, pdf_url, rows, closing_balance, lines, total_outstanding, note?}`

mode.description: Pass 'cron_batch' with x-cron-secret header to run the automated batch. (string ('cron_batch'))

party_type.description: Single mode: party type. Required unless mode='cron_batch'. (one of: string ('company'|'contact'))

party_id.description: Single mode: CRM company or contact ID. (string (uuid))

side.description: Ledger direction; inferred from party flags if omitted. (one of: string ('customer'|'supplier'))

from.description: Period start; defaults to current year start. (string (date YYYY-MM-DD))

to.description: Period end; defaults to current year end. (string (date YYYY-MM-DD))

lang.description: PDF/email language; inferred from workspace country if omitted. (one of: string ('el'|'en'))

dry_run.description: Generate PDF but do not send email.

post.summary: Public online storefront: browse products and submit cart checkout
post.description: Anonymous action-discriminated endpoint for the workspace's public mini-store. 'meta' returns storefront config, 'products' returns published products with prices, 'checkout' validates the cart server-side, creates a draft retail receipt (myDATA 11.1), and returns a Stripe pay link. post.summary: Execute, test, or event-trigger workflow automations by walking the xyflow graph.
post.description:
Requires Supabase JWT. Routes on body.action to execute-flow (run a saved flow with trigger data), test-flow (dry-run, no side effects), or trigger-event (auto-dispatch from DB triggers or server-to-server).

**Response:** `{success: boolean, data: object}`

post.summary: Per-minute cron that fires scheduled flows whose cron expression matches current UTC time.
post.description:
Validates x-cron-secret, fetches active flows with trigger_type='scheduled', evaluates their cron expression against the current time (with timezone support), and invokes flow-engine execute-flow for each due flow. Prevents double-firing with a 55-second last_run_at guard.

**Response:** `{success: boolean, checked: number, triggered: number, results: array}`

post.summary: Receives external HTTP requests and routes them to the matching webhook-triggered flow.
post.description:
Requires flow_id as a query parameter. Validates that the flow has trigger_type='webhook' and is active. Optionally verifies an X-Webhook-Secret header against the secret stored in the flow's trigger_config before delegating to flow-engine execute-flow.

**Response:** `{success: boolean, data: {flow_id: string, run_id: string, status: string}}`

flow_id.description: UUID of the webhook-triggered flow to execute. (string (query param))

post.summary: Render a presentation catalog to a PDF and store it in pdf-documents
post.description:
Builds a multi-page A3 PDF from the catalog's cover/body/back-cover data and selected template, uploads it to pdf-documents/catalog-output/{id}/, and updates presentation_catalogs with the storage path and a fresh signed URL.

**Response:** `{success, pdf_url, pdf_storage_path, page_count}`

post.summary: Multi-mode interior design image generation (Gemini, FLUX, Grok)
post.description:
Generates interior design images across seven modes: text-to-image, image-edit, redesign, copy-style, floor-plan-render, floor-plan-text, and materials-selection-board. Routes to Gemini (flash 6cr / pro 15cr), FLUX Depth Pro (redesign/copy-style 20cr), or Grok Aurora (15cr) based on mode and model_tier. Accepts service-role key for server-to-server calls from agent-chat; otherwise requires user JWT.

**Response:** `[object Object]`

📖 [docs/docs/api/generate-interior-gemini-api.md](docs/api/generate-interior-gemini-api.md)

post.description:
Generates interior design videos via veo-2 (30cr), kling-v3.0 (20cr), wan2.1-i2v-720p (12cr), or runway-gen4-turbo (40cr). Model is auto-selected from video_type when not specified. Replicate-based models poll for up to 50s and return async job_id if not done; frontend polls generation_videos table. Accepts service-role key for agent-chat internal calls.

**Response:** `[object Object]`

post.summary: Render a moodboard presentation sheet or project client-view to PDF
post.description:
Accepts either a sheet_id (renders one of the 9 sheet types: material_board, color_palette, concept_board, lighting_plan, annotated_render, elevation_render_pair, ffe_schedule, area_breakdown, full_deck) or a client_view_id (renders a cross-moodboard project deck). Uploads to pdf-documents and returns a 7-day signed URL.

**Response:** `{success, pdf_url, pdf_storage_path, page_count}`

Builds an A4 branded PDF for a quote using pdf-lib, uploads to pdf-documents storage, and returns a 7-day signed URL. Returns the cached PDF on subsequent calls unless regenerate is requested. Emits a flow event on successful generation.

**Response:** `{success, pdf_url, pdf_storage_path}`

post.summary: Masked inpainting: regenerate a user-painted area of a room image via Grok Aurora
post.description:
Accepts a room image URL, a binary PNG mask data URL (white=regenerate, black=keep), and a prompt. Calls Grok Aurora's /v1/images/edits endpoint with an explicit binary mask. Costs 20 credits. Accepts service-role key for agent-chat internal calls.
